title: 第1章 拿的张伟剧本地狱难度开局第2章 案子来了
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
江海，一座南方人口接近两千万人的巨大城市，是南方的绝对经济中心。
无数纸醉金迷，商场沉浮的故事在这里上演。
而此刻，一座老旧的七层楼房內，一间名为顺和的律师事务所內。
林默长嘆了一声。
“饿啊！“
捂著咕嚕叫的肚子，林默露出了无奈的表情。
没想到自己穿越了，穿越成了一个落魄的律师，口袋空空，已经一天没吃饭了。
饿的脑阔发晕啊！
至於为什么身为律师能够落魄到这个地步，那得亏前身令人窒息的神操作啊！
前身成为正式律师的第一战，代理的是一件赔偿案件。
原告要求我方赔偿500万，本来当事人都准备赔钱了。
结果在前主晓之以理动之以情的自信辩论之下，引起了法院的高度重视！於是重审案件。
细查之下真的发现了新线索！
本书首发????????????.??????，提供给你无错章节，无乱序章节的阅读体验
警方发现，我方当事人不仅损害了原告的利益，还诈骗了十几家公司。
数额巨大。
结果500万的元罚款確实是免除了，但是改判我方20年有期徒刑！
前主一出手便震惊了整个律师界！
直接把自己的委託人给送进去了！
虽然是委託人自身有问题，但是身为专业律师，这种情况是绝对不可能发生的。

进去前，连当事人都无比悔恨的哭泣道：“我怀疑这律师是对方派来的臥底，呜呜呜！”
第二个案子，当事人搞涂鸦，被起诉“故意毁坏財物罪”
量刑標准是5000元，当事人造成的破坏是5500元，达到量刑標准。
前主很自信，直接申请了重新鑑定，结果很喜人，鑑定损坏的结果为4500块，不构成“故意毁坏財物罪”
於是检方又从“寻衅滋事”角度来起诉当事人。
结果....当事人被判了五年有期徒刑。
此案也极其逆天，再一次震惊了律师界。
因为“故意毁坏財物罪”只需要赔钱，如果损害数额巨大，也只是三年以下的有期徒刑。
然而，“寻衅滋事”的量刑可是五年以下有期徒刑！
孰轻孰重一眼便知。
本来当事人只需要赔偿的，结果被前主搞的要坐五年牢....
两次案子打下来，己方委託人全部坐牢，捷报频传！
前主两战成名，把自己委託人送进去坐牢的整个律师届都是第一次见。
於是有了人送外號“律政鬼见愁”
一时间，前主的名气达到了顶峰。
有律政精英表示：“林律师才26岁，出道两起案件就积累了无数前辈一辈子才能达到的名声，真乃律界天才也！”
当然，这种名声不要也罢...
气的前主所在律所赶紧划清界限，直接把他踢了出来。
前主彻底沦为律政界笑柄。
就连同为律师的女朋友也把他踢了，说是怕影响以后自身发展。

没办法，前主只能把身上所有的钱都拿来开了这家“顺和律师事务所”
但由於名气实在太大，谁想不开敢找前主打官司？
屁股痒了，想坐牢了是吧。
於是林默就陷入了如今饿肚子的境地。
content_en:
Jianghai, a huge city in the south with a population of nearly 20 million people, is the absolute economic center of the south.
Countless people are obsessed with life and money, and stories of the ups and downs of the mall are staged here.
At this moment, in an old seven-story building, there is a law firm named Shunhe.
Lin Mo sighed.
"Hungry!"
Holding his growling stomach, Lin Mo showed a helpless expression.
Unexpectedly, I traveled through time and became a down-and-out lawyer with empty pockets and no food for the day.
I'm so hungry that I feel dizzy!
As for why a lawyer can be in such a miserable state, it must be thanks to the breathtaking magic skills of his predecessor!
The predecessor's first battle as a formal lawyer was a compensation case.
The plaintiff demanded compensation of 5 million yuan from us. Originally, the parties involved were prepared to pay compensation.
As a result, the former owner Xiaozhi's confident argument was based on reason but also emotion, which attracted the court's great attention! So the case was reopened.
After careful investigation, I really found new clues!
This book is first released, providing you with a reading experience with no wrong chapters and no out-of-order chapters.
The police discovered that our client not only harmed the interests of the plaintiff, but also defrauded more than a dozen companies.
The amount is huge.
As a result, the fine of 5 million yuan was indeed waived, but our sentence was changed to 20 years in prison!
The former owner shocked the entire legal profession as soon as he took action!
He sent his client in directly!
Although the client himself has the problem, as a professional lawyer, this situation is absolutely impossible to happen.
Before going in, even the client cried with great regret: "I suspect this lawyer is an undercover agent sent by the other party, woo woo woo!"
In the second case, the client engaged in graffiti and was charged with "intentional destruction of property."
The sentencing standard is 5,000 yuan, and the damage caused by the parties is 5,500 yuan, which meets the sentencing standard.
The former owner was very confident and directly applied for a re-appraisal. The result was very gratifying. The result of the appraisal was that the damage was 4,500 yuan, which did not constitute the crime of "intentional destruction of property."
So the prosecutors prosecuted the parties from the perspective of "picking quarrels and provoking trouble."
As a result....the client was sentenced to five years in prison.
This case was also extremely outrageous and once again shocked the legal profession.
Because the crime of "intentional destruction of property" only requires compensation, if the amount of damage is huge, it is only a fixed-term imprisonment of less than three years.
However, the penalty for “picking quarrels and provoking trouble” is imprisonment for up to five years!
You can tell which one is more important at a glance.
Originally the client only needed compensation, but as a result, the ex-owner had to go to jail for five years...
The two cases were settled, all our clients were imprisoned, and good news came frequently!
The former owner became famous after two battles, and it was the first time for him to meet the entire legal profession who sent his client to jail.
So some people gave it the nickname "Law and Government Ghost Seems Worry"
For a time, the former master's fame reached its peak.
Some legal elites said: "Lawyer Lin is only 26 years old. He has accumulated a reputation that only countless seniors can achieve in their lifetimes after just two cases. He is truly a genius in the legal profession!"
Of course, it’s okay not to have this kind of reputation...
The angry law firm where the former boss worked quickly drew a clear line and kicked him out.
The former owner was completely reduced to a laughing stock in the legal circles.
Even his girlfriend, who is a lawyer, kicked him out because she was afraid it would affect his future development.
There was no choice but to use all the money that the former owner had to open this "Shunhe Law Firm"
But because his fame is so great, who would dare to bring a lawsuit against his former boss?
My butt is itchy. I want to go to jail, right?
So Lin Mo fell into the current hungry situation.
